Accelerator Code of Conduct | Backstage Capital Home For Founders For Investors Portfolio Green Room For Founders For Investors Portfolio Green Room Accelerator Code of Conduct Backstage Accelerator is a 3-month program designed to give founders the support they need to reach their next critical milestone. Founders will work with a team of experienced, passionate facilitators and will grow through mentorship, investment capital, and access to resources + networks. We expect all employees, partners, mentors, and community members to adhere to this code of conduct while at Backstage events, workspaces, or while representing Backstage. Values Diversity is strength Underestimated founders exemplify grit. They do more with less. Diverse teams have stronger business outcomes and more innovative ideas. It takes a village Startups don't succeed in isolation. Companies need strong local ecosystems to start, and strong global networks to grow. Success for all Representation matters because everyone deserves the chance to succeed. We're working to create a future where success is shared by founders, their teams, their investors, and their local communities. Anti-Harassment and Anti-Discrimination Backstage Accelerator is dedicated to providing a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, color, sex (with or without sexual conduct and
Accelerator participants violating these rules may be expelled from all Accelerator program activities.
Any participants violating these rules may put their investment at risk, as documented in the Accelerator Founder Agreement.
Sponsors, mentors, partners, customers, speakers and workshop facilitators are also subject to this Code of Conduct.

If an individual engages in harassing behavior, Backstage Studio may take any action they deem appropriate, including warning the offender or removing the individual from all future Accelerator activities.
Distributing, using or being under the influence of recreational drugs is not permitted during Backstage Accelerator program hours or at Accelerator events.
We expect all participants to disclose all conflicts of interests and any legal agreements that could impact their experience during Accelerator.
Participation and Attendance Policies Participants are expected to attend all Accelerator activities and events as stated in the Founder agreement.

Our Commitment We expect all participants to follow these rules at all Backstage Studio and Accelerator programming, venues and social events online and offline, and we commit to following them as well.
It is our goal at Backstage Studio team to create an environment where all Accelerator participants will feel safe, welcome, and able to participate as their full selves.
If you have witnessed a violation of our Code of Conduct, please contact us at accelerator@backstagecapital.com.
The Backstage Accelerator Code of Conduct is a living document.
For suggested changes, please contact us at accelerator@backstagecapital.com.
